name: Speechify Simba 3.2
access: Speechify API: POST /v1/audio/speech, POST /v1/audio/stream and a stream with timestamps, model simba-3.2 [as-of 2026-10-31] The WebSocket input stream GET /v1/audio/stream/ws also takes simba-3.2 [sp-ws]
Integrations: LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Deepgram Voice Agent and Puter

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text or SSML [as-of 2026-10-31] It applies break, prosody (rate, pitch and volume) and sub, and accepts emphasis and speechify:style emotion tags without applying them; pitch and volume are applied from 2026-10-20 [sp-ssml-1031] [sp-chlog-1020]
voice.output_audio: 23 `output_format` values: PCM at 8, 16, 22.05, 24, 44.1 and 48 kHz, mu-law at 8 kHz, MP3 at 22.05 and 24 kHz (32 to 160 kbps; [as-of 2026-10-31] the 192 kbps values are delivered at 160 kbps [sp-formats-1031]), Ogg at 24 kHz, AAC at 24 kHz, and WAV at 24 and 48 kHz (not on streaming); 24 kHz PCM is the model's native output [sp-formats] [sp-latency]
voice.voices: catalogue voices and zero-shot voice cloning from a 10 to 30 second sample with verified consent [sp-models] [sp-clone]
voice.latency: First audio byte 56 ms at the median and 102 ms at p90 on the maker's production streaming path in US East, measured on 2026-09-15 [sp-latency]. [as-of 2026-10-31] On 2026-10-09 the maker measured first audible audio from a client in US East at a median of 47 ms over the WebSocket input stream and 64 ms over the HTTP stream, and 145 ms and 153 ms from Zurich; it also cites Coval at 109 ms and Voice Arena at 123 ms to first audio, which this card did not read [sp-latency-1031]
voice.session_limit: 2,000 characters per /v1/audio/speech request and 20,000 per streaming request [sp-limits]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, drawn from a US dollar balance that a monthly plan grants. Free US$0 (500K characters a month, then pauses), Starter US$10 (1.9M characters, then US$10 per 1M), Pro US$99 (13.5M, then US$8 per 1M) and Scale US$499 (78M, then US$6 per 1M); Enterprise has volume pricing [sp-pricing]. [as-of 2026-10-31] The pricing page now gives a rate per model: these rates are those of Simba 3.2 and 3.0, and Simba 3.5 lists at twice them [sp-pricing-1031]. Artificial Analysis lists US$6.58 per 1M characters for both Simba 3.2 and Simba 3.0 [aa-tts-board-1031]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, 95% CI 1237.46 to 1261.46, read on 2026-10-31 (1241.95 on 2026-10-04)
